title: Gold Just Gave You a SECOND CHANCE… Here’s What I’m Buying
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: First Fed hike since 2023 is a warning shot against 3.4% inflation; gold rose anyway.
China 22 straight months of purchases; record central bank buying and ETF inflows diverging from price.
Gold 22% off its high mirrors the 1976 mid-bull pullback before an 8x run.

calls.reason: Central bank and ETF demand plus money-supply growth; sees 5,000 as the floor, back to 5,600 in H1 2027 and $10,000 within 2-3 years.
calls.quote: This year's highs, 5600 an ounce. I think we're back there in the first half of 2027

calls.reason: Miners at ~15x earnings with record margins (~$2,700/oz profit); 1.5-3x leverage to gold.
calls.quote: this is, in my opinion, one of the best long-term investments you can make right now

calls.reason: Silver tends to outperform gold in rallies, though more volatile and economy-dependent.
calls.quote: silver, does it come along for the ride? Yes, I think it does

notes: No date stated ('last week the Fed raised'; 'join me this Monday live'); listing date used. Gold price implied ~22% below 5,600 (~4,370) but not stated. Long-term gold also $10,000 in 2-3 years.
